item.title: Government to Set Up 'Housing Supply Dashboard'... Prime Minister to Continuously Monitor Supply Situation (정부 ‘주택 공급 상황판’ 설치… 공급 상황 총리가 계속 챙긴다)
item.description:
Government to Set Up 'Housing Supply Dashboard'... Prime Minister to Continuously Monitor Supply Situation (정부 ‘주택 공급 상황판’ 설치… 공급 상황 총리가 계속 챙긴다)

From now on, the Prime Minister will directly oversee the housing supply situation. A 'housing supply dashboard' will also be established within the government. (앞으로는 국무총리가 주택 공급 상황을 직접 챙긴다. 정부 내에 ‘주택 공급 상황판’도 만들어진다.)

The government made this announcement on the 13th alongside the release of measures for the rapid supply of housing and comprehensive financial measures to stabilize the real estate market. (정부는 13일 주택 신속 공급 방안과 부동산 시장 안정을 위한 금융 종합 대책을 발표하면서 이 같은 계획을 함께 발표했다.)

At a joint briefing by relevant ministries held that morning at the Government Seoul Complex, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok said, "To ensure that the government's policy efforts do not end as a one-off, we will establish a pan-governmental special housing supply governance system that can continuously review and supplement the supply situation." (이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 진행된 관계 부처 합동 발표에서 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관은 “정부의 정책적 노력이 일회성에 그치지 않도록, 지속적으로 공급 상황을 점검하고 보완할 수 있는 범정부 특별 주택 공급 거버넌스를 구축하겠다”고 했다.)

Minister Kim added, "We will strengthen the monitoring and coordination functions for the implementation of housing supply by newly establishing a 'Pan-Governmental Housing Rapid Supply Review Meeting' chaired by the Prime Minister, and we will closely manage the supply sites by installing a 'Rapid Supply Innovation Task Force' led by the First Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to actively resolve on-site difficulties together with local governments." (김 장관은 “국무총리 주재 ‘범정부 주택 신속 공급 점검 회의’를 신설해 주택 공급 이행 상황에 대한 점검·조정 기능을 강화하고, 국토부 1차관을 단장으로 ‘신속 공급 혁신단’을 설치해 지방정부와 함께 현장 애로 요인을 적극 해소하는 등 공급 현장을 밀착 관리하겠다”고 했다.)

According to the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Prime Minister will henceforth use the pan-governmental housing rapid supply review meeting to check whether public and private housing supply projects across the country are proceeding without setbacks. When there are projects that fall behind schedule, the meeting will discuss what actions each ministry should take, and the Prime Minister will directly mediate any disagreements between ministries. The first meeting is scheduled for the 14th. (국무조정실에 따르면, 앞으로 총리는 범정부 주택 신속 공급 점검 회의를 통해 전국에서 진행되는 공공·민간의 주택 공급 사업이 차질 없이 진행되는지를 점검하게 된다. 일정이 지연되는 사업이 있을 때는 각 부처가 해야 하는 조치가 무엇인지를 회의에서 함께 논의하고, 부처 간 이견은 총리가 직접 조정하게 된다. 오는 14일 첫 회의를 열 예정이다.)

To support the meeting chaired by the Prime Minister, a 'Housing Rapid Supply Working Meeting' chaired by the Second Deputy Prime Minister for the Office for Government Policy Coordination will also be established. (총래 주재 회의를 뒷받침하기 위해 국무조정실 2차장이 주재하는 ‘주택 신속 공급 실무 회의’도 생긴다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination also launched a 'Housing Rapid Supply Monitoring Team' on the 11th. Comprising five public officials dispatched from the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH), the team will continuously track the progress of each housing supply project across the country and create a 'housing supply dashboard' summarizing the findings for sharing within the government. (국조실 내에는 지난 11일 ‘주택 신속 공급 점검팀’도 생겼다. 국조실과 국토부, 한국토지주택공사(LH)에서 파견된 공직자 5명으로 구성된 팀은 전국에서 진행되는 주택 공급 사업 각각의 진척 현황을 지속적으로 파악하고, 이를 정리한 내용을 담은 ‘주택 공급 상황판’을 만들어 정부 내에 공유하게 된다.)

Office for Government Policy Coordination Chief Lim Ki-geun said, "The success or failure of these (real estate) measures depends on how quickly we supply housing and thereby restore market confidence," adding, "We will constantly monitor the implementation status through the pan-governmental housing supply review system." (임기근 국무조정실장은 “이번 (부동산) 대책의 성패는 얼마나 신속하게 주택을 공급하고 이를 통해 시장의 신뢰를 회복하느냐에 달려 있다”며 “범정부 주택 공급 점검 체계를 통해 이행 상황을 상시 점검하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Even "Goldfish IQ" Comes Up... Late-Stage Race Turns Sharper with 'Short-Hit Negative' Campaigning (“붕어 IQ”까지 나왔다… 與전대 막판 독해지는 ‘단타 네거티브’)
item.description:
Even "Goldfish IQ" Comes Up... Late-Stage Race Turns Sharper with 'Short-Hit Negative' Campaigning (“붕어 IQ”까지 나왔다… 與전대 막판 독해지는 ‘단타 네거티브’)

"The video is preserved as evidence, so why tell such obvious lies? This isn't goldfish IQ." (“영상이 박제가 돼 있는데 뻔한 거짓말을 왜 하느냐. 붕어 IQ도 아니고.”)

On the 13th, four days before the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, party leader candidate Song Young-gil directed these words at his rival candidate Jung Chung-rae. Song claimed on CBS Radio that day that Jung had said right after the June 3 local elections that the party, government, and presidential office had coordinated to assess the election results as a victory, but recently changed his explanation to "coordination between the party and the presidential office." He then attacked Jung, saying "If you're going to lie, you need to be smart," implying Jung doesn't remember his own past statements. <<> Critics point out that after the final TV debate the previous day, the competition among the Democratic Party leadership contenders has devolved into short, provocative "short-hit negative" attacks targeting opponents' verbal slips, past records, and relationships with President Lee Jae-myung, rather than policy and vision. The skirmishes that began in the TV debates have migrated to social media and radio after the debates ended. Jung posted a video of his verbal clash with Song from the previous night on Facebook, writing "Such a big man, but..." He also engaged in a war of nerves with candidate Kim Min-seok, taking issue with his individual word choices. <<> Song escalated his attacks on Jung to new heights that day. After criticizing Jung's response as "slipping away like a loach," he said "He doesn't even have the ability to lie." Last month, he attacked Jung for repeatedly emphasizing his relationship with President Lee, calling it "stalker-level behavior toward President Lee Jae-myung." That day, he also said Jung failed to properly answer what the president's first national task was, calling it "a serious problem and a shameful thing." <<> Jung did not back down either. During the SBS TV debate on the previous day, the 12th, when Song mentioned a conversation he had with President Lee, Jung rebutted that it was inappropriate to publicly disclose details of conversations with the president. When Song tried to explain himself, Jung said, "A man of your size shouldn't make such careless remarks." After the debate, he shared a video of the scene on his Facebook page titled "Older brother Young-gil getting scolded for showing off." <<> A war of nerves even broke out between Jung and Kim over a single word. When Kim said he "commends" (chiha) Jung's one year of party leader activities, Jung responded, "'Commend' is an expression used by superiors toward subordinates" and called it "a disrespectful attitude." Kim shot back, saying "You must have read a Japanese dictionary," noting that in Korean it can also be used between equals. Jung later posted a dictionary search screenshot on Facebook, targeting Kim again. <<> The candidates also continued exchanging "quiz-style questions" under the guise of verifying each other's policy competence. After Song asked Jung about the first national task of the Lee Jae-myung administration in an earlier debate, Jung returned the favor in the final debate by asking Song about national task No. 50. Jung also asked Kim about how much housing supply, among President Lee's housing pledges, should be handled by LH (Land and Housing Corporation), to which Kim objected, saying "A debate among three people should not sink to the level of a quiz show." <<> In the final stretch of the convention, not just current issues but political choices from over 20 years ago and responsibility for past presidential election defeats are being dragged up as attack material. <<> Kim brought up in the final TV debate the previous day an incident where Jung, during the 2022 parliamentary audit, compared temples' cultural property admission fees to "toll fees" and likened temples to "Bongyi Kim Seon-dal" (a classic Korean swindler), sparking conflict with the Buddhist community. Kim argued this hurt the party in the 2022 presidential election and pressed Jung on why he hadn't apologized more actively at the time. <<> Jung immediately brought up Kim's departure from the Democratic Party in 2002 to support candidate Chung Mong-joon. Jung told Kim, "You seem to have betrayal trauma," and Kim shot back by citing Jung's past conflict with the Buddhist community, saying "You ruined the presidential election." Thus, within a policy debate, a party departure from 24 years ago and responsibility for a presidential election from four years ago came to the fore. <<> Throughout this convention, Jung's signature attack word targeting Kim has been "betrayal." Citing Kim's 2002 party departure, Jung said, "Once a betrayer, always a betrayer," and Kim's camp protested this as excessive labeling. Earlier this month, Jung even said of Kim, "He ran away from home for 18 years and now demands the house deed." <<> The clash over the "suspected Shincheonji intervention in the primary" has even spilled into questions of disciplinary action after the convention. When Kim raised the possibility of a specific religious group intervening in the Democratic Party's primary, Jung defined this as "an act subject to sanctions" and said that if he becomes party leader, he will order an ethics investigation. Kim retorted, "Is warning about religious group intervention in the primary an act subject to sanctions? Are you trying to run the party with intimidation?" Jung has maintained through recently that this issue needs to be resolved after the convention. <<> In the dispute over election rules, words like "coup" and "riot" have even surfaced. When some supreme council member candidates demanded giving additional voting opportunities to rights-bearing party members who couldn't vote, Jung called this a "voting coup" and said changing the rules would cause "riots." Even in the supreme council member race, terms like "Ilbe" and "bat" have appeared, showing the emotional battles in the party leader race spreading to the entire leadership contest. <<> In their closing statements at the final TV debate the previous day, all three candidates uniformly emphasized "unity." Jung appealed to "loyalty" to the party, Song said the three candidates share "the same roots" and urged them to work together after the convention, and Kim also pledged to unify the party after the convention. <<> However, critics note that the actual atmosphere within the party is far from that. Even while emphasizing unity, Jung has not withdrawn his plan for an ethics investigation into Kim's Shincheonji-related claims. When asked whether a party split after the convention was even a possibility, Jung said on the 10th, "Don't say such things," adding "I haven't even thought about it." <<> The Democratic Party leadership has also halted open supreme council meetings this week, just before the convention. The supreme council, which typically met on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, will now meet behind closed doors until the convention. The party says there are no particular matters requiring public resolution, but inside and outside the party, interpretations suggest the leadership is trying to prevent further exposure of conflict, as pro-Lee and pro-Jung supreme council members have repeatedly attacked each other's camps in public settings. <<> Voices within the party are also worrying about the aftermath of the primary. Lawmaker Yoon Kun-young recently described this convention as "hot to the point of being on the verge of explosion," saying the party should not end up "uprooting the very pillars of the household" just to win an immediate election. Lawmaker Kim Young-jin also cited the Democratic Party's past history of splits, saying this convention should not go down that path. <<> The Democratic Party's convention preparation committee announced in early last month, before the convention began, that it would take strong action against excessive negativity such as the use of derogatory terms. However, as voting day approaches, the exchanges between candidates have instead grown rougher, moving toward imprinting "lies," "betrayal," and "incompetence" in short phrases rather than addressing each other's policies. A political source said, "The emotional battle has escalated to the point where it's hard to see them as fellow party members fighting each other. If the losing camp cannot be embraced after the 17th decides the winner, the post-convention fallout could last for a considerable time. The new leader's first task will not be winning elections but stitching the party back together." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 나흘 앞둔 13일 송영길 당대표 후보가 경쟁자인 정청래 후보를 향해 이렇게 말했다. 송 후보는 이날 CBS 라디오에서 정 후보가 6·3 지방선거 직후 당·정·청이 선거 결과를 승리로 평가하기로 조율했다는 취지로 말했다가 최근에는 ‘당·청 간 조율’이라고 설명을 바꿨다고 주장했다. 그러면서 “거짓말을 하려면 머리가 좋아야 한다”며 정 후보가 과거 자기 발언을 기억하지 못한다는 취지로 공격했다.)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating at 49%... lowest since taking office [NBS] (李대통령 지지율 49%... 취임 이후 최저치 [NBS])
item.description:
President Lee's approval rating at 49%... lowest since taking office [NBS] (李대통령 지지율 49%... 취임 이후 최저치 [NBS])

A survey result showed that positive evaluations of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs management fell below 50% for the first time since his inauguration, recording the lowest figure. (이재명 대통령에 대한 국정운영 긍정 평가가 취임 후 처음으로 50% 아래로 떨어지며 최저치를 기록했다는 조사 결과가 나왔다.)

In the National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted by Embrain Public, Kstat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on 1,001 people nationwide from the 10th to the 12th and released on the 13th, positive evaluations of the President's state affairs management stood at 49%, while negative evaluations were 43%. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 10~12일 전국 1001명을 대상으로 시행해 13일 발표한 전국지표조사(NBS)에서 이 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정적 평가는 49%, 부정적 평가는 43%로 나타났다.)

The positive evaluation marked the lowest figure since the President took office in the same survey. Among moderate voters, positive and negative evaluations were similar at 47% and 46%, respectively. (긍정 평가는 같은 조사에서 이 대통령 취임 이후 가장 낮은 수치를 기록했다. 중도층에서 긍정 평가와 부정 평가가 각각 47%, 46%로 비슷한 수준이었다.)

Party support ratings were as follows: Democratic Party of Korea 40%, People Power Party 23%, Fatherland Innovation Party 2%, Reform Party 2%, and Progressive Party 1%. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당 40%, 국민의힘 23%, 조국혁신당 2%, 개혁신당 2%, 진보당 1% 등으로 나타났다.)

Regarding the current government's real estate policy, 34% gave a positive evaluation saying it is "doing well," while 56% gave a negative evaluation saying it is "doing poorly." On the real estate tax reform proposal, 46% were in favor and 41% were against. (현 정부의 부동산 정책에 대해선 ‘잘하고 있다’는 긍정 평가가 34%, ‘잘못하고 있다’는 부정 평가는 56%로 나타났다. 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해선 찬성 46%, 반대 41%로 조사됐다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Lee: "Supply cliff from 2022... Secure housing sites even by revising the law" (李 “2022년부터 공급 절벽... 법 개정해서라도 택지 확보”)
item.description:
Lee: "Supply cliff from 2022... Secure housing sites even by revising the law" (李 “2022년부터 공급 절벽... 법 개정해서라도 택지 확보”)

President Lee Jae-myung ordered relevant ministries to launch an "all-out supply war," including aggressively securing housing sites even by revising laws and institutions, and drastically shortening permitting procedures, to resolve the "supply cliff." He also instructed that after policy announcements, opinions from the public and the opposition party be gathered to revise and supplement the measures. (이재명 대통령이 ‘공급 절벽’을 해소하기 위해 법과 제도를 개정해서라도 파격적으로 택지를 확보하고 인허가 절차를 대폭 단축하는 등 ‘전방위적 공급 총력전’에 나설 것을 관계 부처에 지시했다. 아울러 정책 발표 후 국민과 야당의 의견을 수렴해 대책을 수정·보완하라고 했다.)

◇"Aggressive housing site acquisition even at the cost of legal revisions" (◇“법 개정 불사한 파격적 택지 확보”)

In his opening remarks at the meeting, the President identified "supply shortage" as the most urgent issue threatening the current real estate market. "Not only are housing prices in our society extremely high by global standards, but if this situation persists, a so-called 'lost 20 or 30 years' phenomenon could arrive," the President said. "To resolve the time-bomb-like housing problem, we must concentrate all available means and capabilities across supply, tax, and financial policies." (이 대통령은 회의 모두 발언에서 현재 부동산 시장을 위협하는 가장 시급한 문제로 ‘공급 부족’을 꼽았다. 이 대통령은 “우리 사회의 부동산 가격이 전 세계적으로 매우 높을 뿐만 아니라, 이 상황이 지속되면 소위 ‘잃어버린 20년, 30년’ 같은 현상이 도래할 수 있다”며 “시한폭탄 같은 부동산 문제 해결을 위해 공급·세제·금융 정책 전반에 가용한 수단과 역량을 집중 투입해야 한다”고 했다.)

He particularly pointed out structural disruptions in the supply sector. "We have been in a supply cliff state from 2022 until now. Permits have been greatly reduced and construction starts have also declined significantly, inevitably creating a supply cliff, so extraordinary efforts are needed to fill that gap," the President said. However, the opposition party cites the cancellation of large-scale redevelopment and reconstruction projects during former Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon's tenure as a cause of the supply shortage. (특히 공급 부문의 구조적 차질을 지적했다. 이 대통령은 “2022년부터 지금까지 공급 절벽 상태다. 인허가도 매우 축소됐고 착공도 많이 줄어들어서 불가피하게 공급 절벽이 발생했기 때문에, 이를 메우기 위한 특단의 노력이 필요하다”고 했다. 다만 야당은 박원순 전 서울시장 시절 대규모 재개발·재건축 취소 등을 공급 부족 원인으로 꼽는다.)

"Since supply policies involve long lead times and many practical constraints, we must wage an all-out supply war with special resolve," the President said. "We must shorten various permitting procedures as much as possible, and for housing sites, we should not be bound by existing regulations—if necessary, secure them aggressively even by amending laws and institutions to move forward with supply." (이 대통령은 “공급 정책은 소요 기간이 길고 현실적 제한이 많은 만큼 특별한 각오를 갖고 전방위적인 공급 총력전에 나서야 한다”며 “각종 인허가 절차를 최대한 단축하고, 택지도 기존 규제에 얽매이지 말고 필요하면 법과 제도를 고쳐서라도 파격적으로 확보해서 공급에 나서야 한다”고 했다.)

◇"Calling policy refinements 'flip-flopping' is an outdated approach" (◇“정책 보완을 ‘오락가락’이라 부르는 건 낡은 방식”)

The President instructed that after announcing housing supply measures, opinions from the public, experts, and the political sphere be gathered to revise and supplement the policies. "Public officials cannot be 100 percent perfect," the President said. "Drafting the best possible proposal, then incorporating reasonable suggestions from the public and the opposition to make it a more complete set of measures, is the normal policy-making process." (이 대통령은 부동산 공급 대책 발표 이후 국민, 전문가, 정치권의 의견을 수렴해 정책을 수정·보완하라고 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “공무원이 100% 완벽할 수 없다”며 “최선을 다해 안을 만들되 국민과 야당의 합리적인 제안을 수렴해 더 완벽한 대책으로 만들어가는 것이 정상적인 정책 결정 과정”이라고 했다.)

He continued: "Expressing that an initial proposal has changed or has been revised to incorporate reasonable ideas as 'lacking policy consistency,' 'flip-flopping,' or 'patching together a ragbag' is an outdated way of thinking from the past," he said. "Public servants should not be swayed by such criticism but boldly gather opinions from the public, experts, and the opposition, and pragmatically complete well-structured measures that fit the real lives of the people." (이어 “처음 나온 안이 바뀌거나 합리적 안을 수용해 수정했다고 해서 ‘정책 일관성이 없다’ ‘오락가락이다’ ‘누더기를 만들었다’고 표현하는 것은 낡은 과거 방식”이라며 “공직자들은 이런 비판에 구애받지 말고 과감하게 국민과 전문가, 야당의 의견을 수렴해 국민의 실제 삶에 맞도록 실용적인 대책을 짜임새 있게 완성해 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

◇Eliminating the "marriage penalty" and moving away from supplier-centered administration (◇‘결혼 페널티’ 해소 및 공급자 중심 행정 탈피)

The President addressed the so-called "marriage penalty," where marriage actually reduces opportunities for housing lotteries or loans, saying, "When single, men and women each had separate opportunities, but when combined, they decrease—that is unreasonable." He added, "Breaking away from administratively convenient, supplier-centered thinking and continuously improving policies so that people do not perceive unfairness from their perspective is what truly competent administration looks like," urging full efforts to build a "housing ladder" for people's residential stability and homeownership. (이 대통령은 혼인 시 오히려 청약이나 대출 기회가 줄어드는 이른바 ‘결혼 페널티’를 언급하며 “홀몸일 때는 남녀가 따로 기회를 가졌는데 합치니까 오히려 줄어드는 것은 불합리하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “행정 편의적인 공급자 중심 사고에서 벗어나 국민의 시각에서 불공정하다는 생각이 들지 않도록 정책을 끊임없이 개선하는 것이 진짜 유능한 행정”이라며 국민의 주거 안정과 내 집 마련을 위한 ‘주거 사다리’ 구축에 총력을 다할 것을 당부했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Introduce Selective Volunteer System to Become a Smart Strong Military... Pursue Defense Reform" (李대통령 “선택적 모병제 도입해 스마트 강군으로...국방개혁 추진”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Introduce Selective Volunteer System to Become a Smart Strong Military... Pursue Defense Reform" (李대통령 “선택적 모병제 도입해 스마트 강군으로...국방개혁 추진”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 13th regarding military reform, "We must swiftly and thoroughly pursue defense reform to introduce a selective volunteer system and transform our military into a smart, elite, strong force centered on advanced equipment and technology." (이재명 대통령은 13일 군 개혁과 관련해 “선택적 모병제를 도입해 우리 군을 첨단 장비와 기술 중심의 스마트 정예 강군으로 탈바꿈시키려는 국방 개혁을 빠르고 빈틈없이 추진해야 한다”고 말했다.)

At a senior advisors' meeting held at the presidential office that day, President Lee stated, "Due to the continued low birth rate, maintaining the current inefficient military structure focused on manpower and infantry is neither feasible nor desirable." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 수석보좌관 회의에서 “지속적인 저출생 때문에 현재와 같은 인력 중심, 보병 중심의 비효율적 군 구조를 유지하는 것은 가능하지도, 바람직하지도 않다”며 이같이 말했다.)

The "selective volunteer system" mentioned by President Lee is a concept that maintains the conscription system while converting certain specialized fields to a volunteer-based system. (이 대통령이 언급한 ‘선택적 모병제’는, 징병제를 유지하되 일부 전문 분야를 모병제로 전환하는 개념이다.)

President Lee has referred to the selective volunteer system on several occasions. When visiting the Marine Corps Yeonpyeong unit last June, he said, "We will minimize conscripted soldiers and change the system so that people can choose the military as their own workplace through volunteer enlistment." At that time, President Lee personally explained the selective volunteer system, saying, "The intent is that, to the extent possible within the budget, it would be better to choose either becoming long-term professional soldiers who receive fair and sufficient pay, or, if that's not preferred, opting to serve short-term conscription." (이 대통령은 그동안 수차례 선택적 모병제를 언급해 왔다. 지난 6월 해병대 연평부대를 방문했을 때도 “징집병을 최소화하고 모병을 통해 자기 자신의 직장으로 군을 선택할 수 있게 바꿔나가겠다”고 했다. 당시 이 대통령은 선택적 모병제에 대해 직접 설명하면서 “예산이 허용하는 범위 내에서 최대한 가능하면, 정상적이고 충분한 보수를 지급받는 약간의 장기 직업 군인을 선택하든지, 그게 싫으면 단기 징병에 응하는 (것으로) 선택하는 게 낫다는 그런 취지”라고 했다.)

In March, at a meeting of key military commanders held at the Ministry of National Defense, he said, "I ask that you also accelerate defense reform, including the selective volunteer system." (지난 3월엔 국방부에서 열린 전군 주요 지휘관 회의에서 “선택적 모병제 등 국방 개혁에도 속도를 내주기 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "We Will Fight Again Through Lawsuits" After Election Commission Rejects Appeal (장동혁, 선관위 소청 기각에 “소송으로 다시 싸울 것”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "We Will Fight Again Through Lawsuits" After Election Commission Rejects Appeal (장동혁, 선관위 소청 기각에 “소송으로 다시 싸울 것”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on the 13th that, in response to the National Election Commission's rejection of the party's appeal regarding the June 3 Seoul mayoral election, "No one in the public will be able to accept this. We will fight again through election litigation." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 13일 중앙선거관리위원회가 자당이 제기한 6·3 서울시장 선거소청 등을 기각한 데 대해 “국민 누구도 납득할 수 없을 것이다. 선거 소송을 통해 다시 싸우겠다”고 했다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held that morning in Yeouido, Seoul, Jang said, "As expected, the National Election Commission rejected our party's election appeal." The previous day, the NEC ruled on the People Power Party's appeal regarding the Seoul mayoral election and others, citing ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections, stating, "While there were violations of election regulations regarding ballot shortages and voting interruptions in some polling stations, these facts cannot be seen as having affected the election results," and thus rejected the appeal. (장 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “예상했던대로 중앙선관위가 우리 당의 선거소청을 기각했다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 전날 중앙선관위는 6·3 지방선거 당시 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 이유로 국민의힘이 제기한 서울시장 선거 등의 소청에 대해 “일부 투표구의 투표용지 부족 및 투표 중단에 관해서는 선거에 관한 규정을 위반한 사실이 존재하나, 이러한 사실이 선거 결과에 영향을 미친 것으로 볼 수 없다”며 기각 결정을 내렸다.)

Jang criticized the NEC, saying, "Even though ballot shortages and even computer manipulation were revealed, they're saying, 'Since you couldn't prove it affected the election results, we'll just reject it.' This shamelessness and irresponsibility have ultimately led them to grant themselves a pardon." He added, "We will uncover every truth through election litigation and a special counsel investigation." (장 대표는 중앙선관위를 향해 “투표용지 부족에 전산 조작까지 드러났는데도 당신들이 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다는 것을 입증 못했으니 우린 그냥 기각하고 말겠다는 것”이라며 “뻔뻔함과 무책임과 이런 것들이 결국 셀프 면죄부를 내놓게 만들었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “선거 소송과 특검을 통해 모든 진실을 낱낱이 밝히겠다”고 했다.)

Jang also said that evidence has emerged of foreign forces intervening in the elections through public opinion manipulation, and announced plans to push for a system requiring the display of nationality for online comments. "Aside from the NEC, forces threatening democracy have also been exposed," he said. "An international joint research team from KAIST and Germany's Max Planck Institute conducted a full analysis of 112 million Naver comments over ten years and found approximately 24,000 malicious accounts linked to foreign forces." (장 대표는 또 외국 세력이 여론 조작으로 우리 선거에 개입하고 있는 정황이 드러났다며 온라인 댓글 국적 표시제 도입을 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 그는 “선관위 못지않게 민주주의를 위협하는 세력도 드러났다”며 ”KAIST(한국과학기술원)와 독일 막스플랑크연구소 국제 공동 연구팀이 10년 치 네이버 댓글 1억1200만여 건을 전수 분석한 결과 외국 세력과 연계된 악성 계정이 약 2만4000개나 나왔다“고 했다.)

Jang stated, "This is clear evidence that foreign forces are intervening in our elections through public opinion manipulation. The People Power Party will vigorously push for the introduction of a nationality disclosure system for online comments." (장 대표는 “외국 세력이 여론 조작으로 우리 선거에 개입하고 있다는 명백한 증거”라며 “국민의힘은 온라인 댓글 국적 표시제 도입을 강력하게 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The previous day, KAIST announced that research teams led by Professor Lee Won-jae of the Graduate School of Culture Technology and Professors Cha Meeyoung and Oh Hye-yeon of the School of Computing, in collaboration with the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy in Germany, analyzed 20 years of Naver news comment data and identified approximately 24,000 accounts suspected of foreign-linked influence operations. However, the researchers noted that these accounts tended not to support a specific political camp unilaterally, but rather amplified internal conflicts and divisions within Korean society. (전날 KAIST는 이원재 문화기술대학원 교수와 전산학부 차미영·오혜연 교수 연구팀이 독일 막스플랑크 보안·정보보호연구소와 함께 20년간의 네이버 뉴스 댓글 데이터를 분석한 결과 외국 연계 영향력 활동이 의심되는 계정 2만4000여 개를 확인했다고 밝혔다. 다만 연구진은 이 계정들이 특정 정치 진영을 일방적으로 지지하기보다는 한국 사회 내부의 갈등과 대립을 증폭시킨다고 분석했다.)
